thesis: CDNA has a sound post-earnings structure (higher low at 75.81, close 84.42 above SMA20 73.82, revenue +39% YoY, cash 250.5M vs debt 29.0M), but it is a beta-2.49 growth name in a risk-off NASDAQ regime (QQQ 21-day -9.57%, VIX 20.85 and rising). The 1.8 reward/risk relies on a breakout to 96.4 beyond the 90.87 52-week high (only about 1.1 to that high), the bull's own target probability is 0.35, and the news/SEC feeds were down, so offering risk and the cause of the gap and the 11% drop on 2026-11-05 cannot be checked. Wait for the regime to stabilise and the news feed to return before taking a position.
invalidation: A daily close below 75.81 (the 2026-11-05 higher low), or a close back below the 80.61 gap-day open on rising volume, breaks the bullish structure.
key_risks: Risk-off regime led by tech and semiconductors (QQQ below 50- and 200-day, SMH 21-day -19.21%) hitting a beta-2.49 name
News and SEC filing feeds unavailable: equity raise (S-3/424B5) after a roughly +390% 126-day run cannot be ruled out
Gap-fill risk toward 80.61 and 75.81; ATR 5.51 is 6.5% of price
Rich valuation (forward P/E 53.5, P/S 8.9, EV/EBITDA 164) with sequentially slowing revenue growth and non-recurring Q2 profit
Price at the top of the entry zone; first resistance at the 90.87 high gives only about 1.1 reward/risk
